subject: Follow-up: Post-demo & pricing options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@startupx.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Post-demo & pricing options

Hey Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap + next steps from our side:

- Token profile: you mentioned ~50M input tokens/month (ingestion) + ~150M generation tokens/month across chat and batch jobs; peak QPS during launches ~65-80 reqs/sec.
- Primary workload: conversational agents + reranking for search. Latency SLO target: 250–300ms P95.
- Current priority: cost predictability. You asked for target unit economics in the ballpark of $700–$900 per 1M tokens to make the use case viable.

Next steps I promised:
1) Share committed-use pricing tiers (monthly and annual) + startup program discounts.
2) Estimate cost for the token profile above with 1x and 3x burst scenarios.
3) Provide a short checklist for procurement (SOC2, contract flow).

I attached an initial pricing workbook (redwood_pricing_v2.xlsx) that has: baseline pay-as-you-go, 12-month committed tiers at 10%, 20%, 30% discounts depending on commit, and a separate startup program worksheet. Please take a look.

Couple clarifying Qs to help me firm numbers:
- For the 150M gen tokens/month, is that steady-state or do you expect 2–3x spikes during launches? (you mentioned a 3-month ramp).
- What budget band would make a committed 12-month discount attractive? (e.g., committed spend $X/month or $Y/year)

If it helps, I can put together a concrete 12-month liquidity/discount proposal that includes multi-year incentives (18–24 months) and an initial credit for startups. Happy to hop on a 30-min follow-up tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood_pricing_v2.xlsx (Excel workbook, 2 sheets)

From: Alex Johnson <alex@startupx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@startupx.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Post-demo & pricing options

Thanks Marissa — really useful recap. A few quick answers and context:

- Token profile: the 50M/150M numbers are our internal estimates for steady-state at month-6 post-launch. We expect 2x spikes for major marketing pushes (so plan for 300M gen tokens/month peak).
- Budget: we're an early-stage startup with a seed round; aiming to keep infra at <$8k/month initially, but if we can get committed discounts that bring effective unit price near $600–$700 per 1M tokens, we could commit to a 12-month plan in the $60k–$80k annual range.
- Startup program: definitely interested. Do you have a formal application/process or is this done via sales?

On commitments: I'd be most interested in 12-month and 24-month commit options. A multi-year incentive (e.g., additional 10% on top of commit discount for 24m) would be highly attractive. Also, curious about volume bands where the per-1M token drops (e.g., >100M gen tokens/month).

Please send a sample committed-use pricing table (monthly and annualized) and the startup discount terms. If the math looks good, we can fast-track legal and procurement.

—Alex
Alex Johnson | Head of Product, StartupX
alex@startupx.com

Alex — great, thanks for the transparency on budget and spikes. I pulled together two clean options in the attached workbook and summarized below:

Option A — 12-month committed use (recommended for predictable costs)
- Commit: 200M gen tokens/month (covers steady-state + 1.25x buffer)
- Discount: 20% off list for 12-month commit
- Effective price: ~$640 per 1M tokens (annualized)
- Startup credit: one-time $5k onboarding credit applied to month 1
- Legal: standard SOW + MSA; can use Redwood redlines or accept limited StartupX redlines.

Option B — 24-month commit (best unit economics)
- Commit: 150M gen tokens/month
- Discount: 30% off list
- Additional multi-year incentive: extra 10% credit applied over 24 months (effectively ~36% benefit in year 1/2 amortized)
- Effective price: ~$580 per 1M tokens (annualized)
- Startup credit: $10k one-time onboarding credit

Notes:
- We can add volume tiers above 300M gen tokens/month for incremental discounts; workbook has >300M, >500M tiers.
- If you need a formal startup program application, I've attached the brief PDF (startup_discount_application.pdf) — we can process via sales and ops in ~3–5 business days.
- I'll loop Dylan (contracts) and Laura (sales lead) to help with procurement and legal next steps.

Next actions:
- If Option A or B looks good, reply with preferred commit length and I’ll generate a term sheet + SOW and fast-track to legal.
- If you want to explore a blended plan (start with 12m then convert to 24m with retroactive credit) we can model that — good for startups with uncertain growth.

Would you have 20–30 minutes Friday to walk through the workbook? I can have a printed term sheet ready.

Thanks,
Marissa
